variants.label: 薄緣外張盆
variants.prompt: Create ONE beautiful, polished, standalone mobile UI icon for pulling up a GOLDEN WASHBASIN, matching the attached approved B Botanical Line search/star icon family. The WASHBASIN SHAPE itself must be elegant and instantly recognizable. A domestic round metal washbasin, NOT a food bowl, dinner plate, rectangular storage box, pet bowl, bathtub, cooking pot, gold ingot or trophy. Use a continuous graceful circular silhouette in three-quarter perspective, a visible hollow oval opening, slender rolled lip, smoothly flared sides with a softly rounded lower contour. Restrained solid buttery gold #FFD778 on the basin, pale cream #FFF1DB inner surface, refined rounded sage #55735B contour approximately 3.5% of total icon width, not heavy cartoon black edging. Match reference family through palette and smooth geometry. No gradients or rendering effects; just 2-3 flat color areas, no decorative patterns, no leaves, no handles, no feet, no ground/shadow, no motion streaks. ONE short coral #F36C63 open-stroke UP arrow centered above the REAR rim, small and subordinate to basin, touches rim; no giant arrow, no upload tray symbol. Square transparent RGBA image. Basin centered, occupies about 76% canvas width and 43% canvas height; total including arrow ~58% height. Wide negative space around it. No text, faces, limbs, label, grid, background tile or scene. Critical: pleasing proportions, thin rim, no thick triple-concentric rings, preserve believable curved circular metal-basin form. Form 1: classic elegant flared Chinese round washbasin, broad thin rolled lip projects modestly beyond bowl sides, moderately shallow basin depth about 28 percent of rim width, gently sloping inward walls taper to a smaller softly rounded bottom. Opening a beautiful clean ellipse, interior cream. Front lip butter gold thin band, body pale warm gold. The rim is a smooth coherent thin structure, only one inner mouth contour.
